# Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS)

> > The official portal for Medicare, Medicaid, and CHIP programs, providing enrollment guidance, coverage policies, provider resources, and healthcare data for beneficiaries and healthcare professionals.

CMS is a federal agency within the Department of Health and Human Services responsible for administering Medicare, Medicaid, and the Children's Health Insurance Program (CHIP). The site serves beneficiaries, healthcare providers, researchers, and policymakers with comprehensive information on program eligibility, coverage determinations, enrollment procedures, and healthcare statistics.

## Key Topics

- Medicare
- Medicare Advantage
- Medicare Part A & B
- Medicare Part D (Prescription Drug Coverage)
- Medicaid
- Provider Enrollment
- Medicare Coverage Determinations
- Telehealth
- Medigap
- Clinical Trials
- Physician Fee Schedule
- Drug Pricing
- Healthcare Programs
- Enrollment & Eligibility
- Fraud Prevention

## Medicare Enrollment & Eligibility

- [Original Medicare (Part A and B) Eligibility and Enrollment](https://www.cms.gov/medicare/enrollment-renewal/original-part-a-b): Guide to Medicare Part A and B eligibility and enrollment requirements.
- [Medicare Managed Care Eligibility and Enrollment](https://www.cms.gov/medicare/enrollment-renewal/managed-care-eligibility-enrollment): Medicare Advantage and Part D enrollment and eligibility guidance.
- [Medicare Prescription Drug Eligibility and Enrollment](https://www.cms.gov/medicare/enrollment-renewal/part-d-enrollment-eligibility): Part D prescription drug coverage eligibility and enrollment information.
- [Health Plans - General Information](https://www.cms.gov/medicare/enrollment-renewal/health-plans): Overview of Medicare Advantage and health plan contracting information.

## Medicare Coverage & Benefits

- [Medicare Coverage Determination Process](https://www.cms.gov/medicare/coverage/determination-process): National coverage determination process and evidence-based review guidance.
- [Prescription Drug Coverage - General Information](https://www.cms.gov/medicare/coverage/prescription-drug-coverage): Medicare Part D prescription drug coverage overview and plan information.
- [Telehealth](https://www.cms.gov/medicare/coverage/telehealth): Medicare telehealth coverage, qualifying services, and billing guidance.
- [Medicare Dental Coverage](https://www.cms.gov/medicare/coverage/dental): Medicare dental coverage policies and medically necessary procedures.
- [Coverage with Evidence Development](https://www.cms.gov/medicare/coverage/evidence): Coverage with evidence development and clinical study requirements.

## Provider & Supplier Resources

- [Become a Medicare Provider or Supplier](https://www.cms.gov/medicare/enrollment-renewal/providers-suppliers): Step-by-step enrollment guide for Medicare providers and suppliers.
- [Annual Medicare Participation Announcement](https://www.cms.gov/medicare-participation): Medicare participation requirements and enrollment guidance for providers.
- [Prescription Drug Coverage Contracting](https://www.cms.gov/medicare/coverage/prescription-drug-coverage-contracting): Part D contracting requirements and pharmacy access guidelines.

## Medicare Coverage Reference & Data

- [Medicare Approved Facilities/Trials/Registries](https://www.cms.gov/medicare/coverage/approved-facilities-trials-registries): Medicare facility certification and clinical trial registry requirements.
- [Medicare Summary Notice](https://www.cms.gov/medicare/coverage/summary-notice): Medicare Summary Notice documentation and technical guidance.
- [Medicare Coverage Related to Investigational Device Exemption (IDE) Studies](https://www.cms.gov/medicare/coverage/investigational-device-exemption-ide-studies): Medicare coverage for investigational device exemption clinical trials.
- [Drug Coverage Claims Data](https://www.cms.gov/medicare/coverage/prescription-drug-claims-data): Part D claims data and TrOOP calculator for prescription drug coverage.

## Research, Data & Agency Information

- [Research, Statistics, Data & Systems](https://www.cms.gov/data-research): CMS data portal with Medicare, Medicaid, CHIP research and statistics.
- [About CMS](https://www.cms.gov/about-cms): Agency overview of CMS mission, leadership, and healthcare programs.
- [Newsroom Homepage](https://www.cms.gov/about-cms/contact/newsroom): CMS newsroom with press releases and fact sheets on Medicare programs.

## Gateway

- [Home - Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services](https://www.cms.gov): CMS homepage with Medicare, Medicaid, and healthcare program resources.
